record.title: Transforming street works operations for M Group Services
record.description: Over 12 years, Sopra Steria has helped M Group Services deliver safer, more efficient and scalable street works operations across the UK.

record.title: Supporting the digital transformation of one of the country’s favourite online retailers
record.description: N Brown is a leading UK digital retail platform for clothing, footwear, home and technology,  best known for its JD Williams, Simply Be and Jacamo brands.

record.title: Transforming Shared Services with a large public body
record.description: Sopra Steria Next has worked with a large public body since 2021 to successfully transition to an Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solution.

record.title: Sopra Steria and IDEMIA: Strengthening border security in the Schengen area
record.description: Sopra Steria and IDEMIA have been selected by eu-LISA to build a new EU-wide biometric system to enhance Schengen border security, unifying major databases as part of the Smart Borders initiative.

record.title: Building the foundations for AI at AB Dynamics
record.description: AB Dynamics partnered with Sopra Steria to kick-start strategic AI adoption, turning uncertainty into targeted initiatives that enhance software development and customer support.

record.title: Making healthcare services more flexible
record.description: Hemit delivers future-oriented digital solutions and services to hospitals in Central Norway. Now Sopra Steria will help them work even more efficiently.

record.title: Prioritising, modernising and protecting over 2,000 applications at Defra
record.description: Sopra Steria was appointed to support with a multi-year programme of work addressing the legacy estate risks at Defra.

record.title: Civil Aviation Authority - Building foundations for better customer experiences.
record.description: cxpartners, the research and design team within Sopra Steria Next UK, worked with The Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) to build foundations for better customer experiences.

record.title: Digital transformation and customer-centred organisation change for SSE
record.description: cxpartners, part of Sopra Steria Next UK, partnered with SSE Energy Solutions to create customer-driven digital services, reshape internal processes, and drive faster, more efficient experiences for their business customers.

record.title: Accelerating innovative expansion using a strategic approach to Cloud technology
record.description: The Wilhelmsen group operates the largest maritime network on the planet, with over 2,200 locations worldwide. In order to accelerate its pace of innovation, while reducing both IT cost management and carbon emissions, Wallenius Wilhelmsen decided to move its full IT landscape into the Cloud. With 9,500 employees across 70 countries, 130 cargo vessels, 120 processing centers for cars and heavy equipment, 15 trade routes on six continents, this IT landscape supports some critical IT processes.

record.title: Norad and Sopra Steria help children all over the world to learn in their own language
record.description: The Global Digital Library (GDL) is an ambitious project leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and cloud solutions to make available a wide range of open learning resources to help combat illiteracy among children.

record.title: Supporting the Scottish Government’s aspirations to becoming an Ethical Digital Nation
record.description: We’re delighted to have worked with the Digital Citizen Unit to most effectively advance Scotland’s Ethical Digital Nation ambitions.

record.title: How meemoo used ethical AI to unmask 3.3 million faces from Flanders’ past
record.description: We've partnered with meemoo, the Flemish Institute for Archives, to enhance accessibility and usability of digitised cultural heritage items through AI-driven metadata enrichment.

record.title: Enagás redefines its software for planning the distribution of gas between plants
record.description: We've partnered with Enagás to redefine its SPLIT system – a new web system designed to plan daily regasification at each facility based on expected ship arrivals.

record.title: Identification and verification innovation for the Northern Ireland Prison Service
record.description: Innovative tech combination empowers inmates and unlocks vital resource

record.title: Driving digital and IT transformation for SNCF
record.description: Sopra Steria helped SNCF modernise its IT by migrating 90% of applications to the cloud, improving scalability, security, and cost efficiency.

record.title: Creating an online pension drawdown journey for Hargreaves Lansdown
record.description: Our centre of excellence utilises the specialist capability that exists in our CX practice called cxpartners.

record.title: Saving the NHS millions – achieving huge economies of scale with innovation and best practice
record.description: NHS SBS delivers award-winning services that empower NHS trusts to focus on strategic decision-making, drive business improvement, and redirect resources to frontline patient care.

record.title: Airbus - Creating value from IT project management
record.description: Airbus IM partnered with Sopra Steria to supply a bundled project management service built around a catalogue of services including project management from initiation to completion, validation testing and acceptance.

record.title: Designing the new omnichannel strategy for an international non food retailer in Italy
record.description: The Client is currently the largest omnichannel distributor of consumer electronics and household appliances by number of outlets in Italy with a network of over 500 direct stores and affiliates in Italy.

record.title: Enabling zCloud transition for a leading UK digital fashion retailer
record.description: The retailer selected an IBM ‘zCloud’ solution, with network approach and configuration designed by Sopra Steria, providing the required level of security, access and resilience to better withstand problems and protect the company’s systems at all times.

record.title: Offer customers online grocery shopping with home delivery in Italy
record.description: The Client is a Supermarket chain which specializes in smaller size retail locations enabling the company to deliver characteristics of large distributors and the experience of a local shop.

record.title: Addressing the many objectives and challenges of a leading UK retail bank
record.description: Our client decided to end the long-term partnership so that it could trade independently; its products and services were currently available via many channels including in-store and online.

record.title: Lantis – AI that empowers people, not replaces them
record.description: Lantis plays a key role in the mobility development of the Antwerp region with projects such as the Oosterweel Connection. The organisation faced a major challenge: the IT team was overwhelmed by daily operations, while employees lost valuable time searching for documents, procedures and contracts. Crucial knowledge risked becoming fragmented in a maze of systems and people.

record.title: Preparing Nursing Students with VR Training for Real-World Challenges
record.description: Discover how Sopra Steria and Landstede transformed nursing education with VR, preparing students for real-world healthcare challenges and emergencies.

record.title: Data Science Team Management at Argenta
record.description: Sopra Steria helped Argenta enhance data science outcomes by managing team skills, interests, and facilitating a migration to a modern working environment.

record.title: Improved customer experience at ING
record.description: Sopra Steria helped ING Belgium improve customer experience using process mining, driving actionable insights and monitoring improvements across services.

record.title: Marketing intelligence at ING
record.description: Sopra Steria helped ING grow its predictive analytics, delivering two million high-quality marketing targets annually and expanding marketing intelligence.

record.title: Recommendation of out-of-stock items for Delhaize
record.description: Sopra Steria helped Delhaize enhance online experience with an AI-powered out-of-stock recommendation model, improving accuracy and customer satisfaction.

record.title: Creating reliable dashboards for the European Climate Foundation
record.description: Explore how Sopra Steria helped the European Climate Foundation transform messy dashboards into powerful, trusted tools for smart decisions.

record.description: Discover how Bleckmann partnered with Python Predictions to build a focused data strategy, creating a clear roadmap to accelerate data-driven growth.

record.title: Ecopower goes for SAP S/4HANA
record.description: Learn how Ecopower modernised its IT systems with SAP S/4HANA, supporting sustainable growth and a decentralised green energy future.

record.title: Ecopower improves cyber-maturity of organization
record.description: Ecopower is a cooperative producer and supplier of renewable energy. Customers, both private and professional, who co-invest in this production, can also consume Ecopower electricity. Ecopower’s activities contribute to a democratic, decentralized and sustainable energy system based on 100% renewable energy for electricity, heating and mobility. By having citizens co-owning wind turbines, solar panels, small water powerplants and a pellet factory and taking democratic control of their own energy production and supply, they drive the awareness of and support for renewable energy in our society.

record.title: TM Roco Tailors Cost Estimations and Optimises Operations for Oosterweel Junction
record.description: At Sopra Steria, our commitment to delivering tailored, complex and innovative solutions is exemplified in our collaboration with TM Roco. This conglomerate of ten companies involved in the monumental Oosterweel junction project sought an effective solution for their construction estimations, leading to our partnership facilitated by DEME.

record.title: Fiera Milano improves its Customer Experience with Cloud Data solution
record.description: Fiera Milano is the domestic market leader and one of the main integrated operators worldwide in the exhibition and congress sector. Fiera Milano has been listed in the STAR segment of the Euronext Milan stock market since 2002. To better serve its thousands of customers and millions of visitors, Fiera Milano has embraced a major Digital Transformation, part of its “CONN.E.C.T. 2025” Strategic Plan including a Data Management Program. With the objective to become a data-driven company, the leading fair company has decided to create a new integrated Data Platform. The company awarded Sopra Steria to perform the design, build and implement the Data Platform supporting the entire information assets.

record.title: Semantic data modeling at the National Police
record.description: Image being a Police officer. Your task is to enforce the law and help those that are in need. And although you have many colleagues, there is always a lot to do. You need to be informed fast and correctly so you can act quickly on the most urgent and serious case. You need to be able to inform others, so they can do the same. And you need to be careful: you are dealing with information about real people. Some are criminals, some are in need of help, and some are actually the victim of a crime.

record.title: Royal FloraHolland implements SAP BRIM
record.description: Royal FloraHolland is a cooperative organization that operates as an auction and wants to handle invoices in a homogenous way. This client-centered organization had high demands for the software to be implemented: it has to be standardized and able to process high volumes (millions of lines of invoices pass through the system daily). It also needs to be robust and able to handle foreign currency and tax rates because of FloraHolland’s ambition to expand beyond borders.

record.title: Datadrevet virksomhedsanalyse og udvikling af dataplatform for Stokke
record.description: Artiklen beskriver, hvordan Sopra Steria hjalp Stokke med at modernisere deres dataplatform og rapporteringssystem for at understøtte effektivitet, præcise produktomkostninger og datadrevne beslutningsprocesser.
